patterns.message: Fixed waits are forbidden. Use a web-first assertion (await expect(locator).toBeVisible()) or page.waitForResponse().
'networkidle' is unreliable. Assert the UI state you need instead.
force: true hides real actionability problems. Wait for the element to be ready instead.
page.pause() is for local debugging only. Use --debug instead.
.only must never be committed. Run a single test via CLI filter instead.
Use locators with web-first assertions instead of waitForSelector.
Disabling lint rules is not allowed. Fix the code; if the rule is wrong for this case, explain it to the user.
Do not silence the type checker. Fix the types.
Fixed delays are forbidden. Wait for a concrete condition.
